title: Electrospray Ionization Mass Spectrometry Insights into the Assembly of Lanthanide-Containing Clusters
claim: Time- and condition-dependent ESI-MS can test proposed lanthanide-cluster assembly pathways by tracking the appearance and evolution of intermediate compositions.
explanation: The review uses hydrolysis, time-dependent, temperature-dependent, and base-dependent measurements to relate detected smaller species to subsequent larger assemblies and to guide reaction conditions.
scope: Solution-phase assembly of ionizable lanthanide-containing clusters.
conditions: Acquire spectra during the reaction or across controlled changes in time, temperature, or base addition.
caveats: Detected compositions and their temporal correlations constrain a pathway but do not, on their own, prove every structural step or capture every intermediate.
